
DESCRIPTION
Install One CLI Coding Agent Skills

USAGE
  one skills [flags]

SUBCOMMANDS
  install        Install or refresh the bundled Coding Agent Skills

TIPS
把 bundled one-cli / one-migrate skills 装到本机选定的 coding agent。

子命令：
  one skills install   安装 / 刷新 bundled skills 到本机

COMMON OPTIONS
  -o, --output <value>     Output format: json | yaml | text (default: terminal-friendly text, JSON when piped)
